name: context-keeper
description: Live context-window panel: what fills it, checkpoints before you compact or clear, and nudges before you hit the wall.

warnAt.title: Warn at context %
warnAt.description: Toast a tip when the context window passes this percentage.

checkpointAt.title: Auto-checkpoint at context %
checkpointAt.description: Write a handoff note automatically when the context passes this percentage (0 turns it off).
